EdwCustomTableConfig.Name: GRP__RootMNGNames
EdwCustomTableConfig.CreateViewQuery:
CREATE VIEW [Finance].[vw_GRP__RootMNGNames] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
WITH RootMNGNames AS ( SELECT PR.ParentOrganizationID as OrgPK, PR.RelatedParty as RelatedParty, PR.RelatedParty as RootOrg FROM Organization.BAS__OrganizationRelatedParty PR WHERE PR.PartyType = 'MNG' AND PR.CompanyKey IS NULL AND PR.RelatedParty NOT IN (SELECT ParentOrganizationID FROM Organization.BAS__OrganizationRelatedParty WHERE PartyType = 'MNG')
UNION ALL
SELECT PR2.ParentOrganizationID as OrgPK, PR2.RelatedParty as RelatedParty, PRH.RootOrg FROM RootMNGNames PRH INNER JOIN Organization.BAS__OrganizationRelatedParty PR2 ON PR2.RelatedParty = PRH.OrgPK WHERE PR2.PartyType = 'MNG' AND PR2.CompanyKey IS NULL )
SELECT RM.OrgPK, RM.RelatedParty, RM.RootOrg, OH.FullName as MNGName, RelatedOrg.FullName as RelatedMNGName FROM RootMNGNames RM INNER JOIN Organization.BAS__Organization OH ON OH.OrganizationID = RM.RootOrg INNER JOIN Organization.BAS__Organization RelatedOrg ON RelatedOrg.OrganizationID = RM.RelatedParty
